- Add $4 \rightarrow -4$.

The pattern of the increments is halving (approximately) until it hits zero.
$4, 2, 1, 0, 0, \dots$

Once the increment becomes $0$, the sequence has reached a fixed point or a stable state. Since the last three differences are all $0$, the term remains $-1$. It is highly likely that the next difference will also be $0$, keeping the value constant.
